metadata.title: Your Memory Deletes Itself (Scary Science) #Shorts
metadata.description: Your brain edits memories, hides truth, and decides before you do. Which fact scared you most? Comment below. #Shorts #PsychologyFacts #BrainFacts

audio_profile.bg_music_vibe: low synthwave drone with heartbeat pulse

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Your memory deletes itself. Every single night. And nobody warned you.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: abstract neurons firing dark purple background macro slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: While you sleep tonight, your brain quietly runs maintenance. It deletes memories to save space.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: sleeping person moonlight window dark bedroom cinematic slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Scientists call it synaptic pruning. Memories you don't reuse are erased. Forever.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: glowing synapse connections abstract dark background macro

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Worse. Every single recall corrupts the file. Your clearest memory is partly fiction.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: vhs tape glitch static retro distorted screen macro

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: That precious childhood memory you treasure? It gets rebuilt every single time you replay it.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: child hands old photograph faded vintage macro nostalgic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Like a rumor passed through a hundred mouths. It never survives the journey intact.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: whisper chain silhouettes dark corridor cinematic moody

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: So the real question isn't what you remember. It's what survived the edit.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: film reel strips burning edge dark cinematic macro slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Follow now. Before tonight's sleep deletes this video too.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: abstract dark particles dissolving black background cinematic slow
